_registryNotes.cleveland-st-casimir-identity: Cleveland has TWO St. Casimirs. The twin-towered church at 8223 Sowinski Ave (Commons photos by Tim Evanson et al.) is the POLISH parish (closed 2009, reopened 2012 by Rome). Our Lithuanian record sv-kazimiero-cleveland-oh is the parish formed by the 2009 St. George + Our Lady of Perpetual Help merger, worshiping in the Neff Road church. Sowinski Ave images must never attach to sv-kazimiero-cleveland-oh, sv-jurgio-cleveland-oh, or dievo-motinos-nuolatines-pagalbos-cleveland-oh. Adjudicated with the Hearth session 2026-07-26.
